title: Train
body:
Amtrak's Auto Train runs overnight from Lorton, Virginia to Sanford, Florida, near Orlando, and your car rides along. You have to bring a vehicle to book it.

It leaves every day at 4:00 PM and arrives at 8:59 AM. Check Amtrak for your date.

title: Beverages
body:
Beer, Wine, Soda, Juice, Various tropical cocktails (alcoholic and non-alcoholic) and Jungle Juices will be available.

Open bar will not have liquor to order, but if you have a bottle you want to bring, we'll have plenty of cooler and bar space to serve you from it.
